title: MetaAligner: Towards Generalizable Multi-Objective Alignment of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs on a 'Harmlessness' objective (defined as avoiding offensive, discriminatory, or harmful content) using GPT-4 as a judge to calculate win rates against baseline and ground-truth responses on the HH-RLHF dataset.

Evaluating a zero-shot 'Fairness' objective (defined as avoiding biased or one-sided arguments and considering different points of view) by prompting GPT-4 to score and compare aligned versus unaligned responses on the UltraFeedback dataset.
